Task: Write a short notice to parents about a school trip next week.

Instruction from the supervisor:
Gather the key details needed for a school trip notice to parents happening next week: destination, date and departure/return times, what students should bring, cost or permission-slip requirements, supervision arrangements, and any contact person. If any detail is not known, say so explicitly and suggest a reasonable placeholder (e.g., [DATE]) rather than inventing facts.

|---|---|---|
| Destination | Unknown | [DESTINATION] |
| Date | Unknown ("next week") | [DATE] |

Subject: Upcoming School Trip to [DESTINATION]

Trip details:
- Departure: [DEPARTURE TIME] from [MEETING POINT]
- Return: [RETURN TIME] at [PICKUP POINT]
- Trip leader: [TEACHER NAME]
- Cost: [COST]
- Please bring: [ITEMS TO BRING]

Please sign and return the permission slip by [PERMISSION SLIP DUE DATE] to [RETURN TO TEACHER/OFFICE].

If you have any questions, please contact [CONTACT NAME, PHONE, EMAIL]. We are happy to help.

Thank you for your continued support. We look forward to a fun and memorable day with your child.

Warm regards,

[TEACHER NAME]
On behalf of the school team
